subject: Request: ramp-clause exception & early-termination credit bucket — HelioHealth
messages:
From: Avery Stone <avery.stone@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options

Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here; HelioHealth is comfortable with most commercial terms but we have one sticking point from our legal/finance partners: the 12-month ramp commitment paired with the early-termination penalty is a hard stop for our board. They need an explicit, negotiable opt-out for pilots that underperform after live launch.

Can Redwood provide an alternate arrangement so we can proceed? Our preference is: a 60-day notice for early termination, and a defined "credit bucket" capped at a percentage of remaining committed spend (not a full refund). We are willing to accept a stepped downsell schedule (staircase) to reduce capacity gradually, but we cannot be locked into the full-term financial liability for a pilot.

Attached: PO draft and SOC2 summary.

Let me know what tradeoffs you can accept — from our side we can accept a modest upfront discount in exchange for more flexible offramps.

Best,
Avery
Procurement, HelioHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Stone <avery.stone@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options

Avery — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the context. We want HelioHealth to succeed and don't want contractual language to block the POC. I need to escalate a non-standard ramp/early-termination structure to Deal Desk + Sales Leadership for approval. Quick summary of what you asked for and what we'll propose back: 

- You asked: 60-day notice, capped credit bucket (percentage of remaining committed spend), staircase downsell allowed.
- Our current standard: 12-month commit with limited early-termination credits (usually pro-rated and tied to notice windows).

Proposed compromise (subject to exec approval):
- 6-month staircase (customer may downscale in 2 steps over 6 months).
- Early-termination with 60-day notice. If terminated, Redwood issues a credit bucket equal to 40% of remaining committed value (applied against future invoices or credits).
- One-time concession: 20% up-front discount on the first 3 months of usage.

I will route this to Deal Desk and Finance now. Can you confirm HelioHealth is okay with credits (non-cash refunds) and a 60-day notice? Also confirm whether the PO needs to reference a DocuSign amendment or a standard SOW change.

Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options — HelioHealth (deal HHL-2027-319)

Team — forwarding HelioHealth's procurement note requesting a departure from standard ramp/early-termination terms. They are willing to take a modest discount in exchange for guaranteed offramp protections.

Decision requested: approval (or amendment) for the following exception:
- Allow 60-day notice early termination with a credit bucket equal to 40% of remaining committed spend (credit-only, no cash refund).
- Implement a 6-month downsell staircase to scale capacity down in two steps (month 1–3: 75% of committed; month 4–6: 50% of committed), then option to terminate with notice.
- Approve a one-time 20% discount on months 1–3 (applies to committed units only).

Constraints/notes: Credits should be applied to future Redwood invoices or toward additional services; not available as cash refunds. Legal will need to redline the SOW amendment. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/319-HHL

Asking for an approval or suggested edits by EOD today — they want to get this into a signed amendment next week.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options — HelioHealth (deal HHL-2027-319)

Approve in principle with a single modification: reduce the credit bucket to 35% of remaining committed value (credit-only) instead of 40%. This preserves our revenue protection while giving the customer a meaningful offramp.

Also require that any discount be time-boxed and explicitly linked to the pilot (months 1–3) and conditioned on no retroactive consumption credits. Approve contingent on Finance review of ARR impact (Soojin, please pull P&L delta).

Sean
VP, Sales Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options — HelioHealth (deal HHL-2027-319)

Marissa / Team — Legal reviewed the concept and provided a short set of redlines; main points: 
- Credit bucket must be explicitly non-transferable and expire after 12 months.
- Staircase language to include a limit on total downsell steps (max 2) and a minimum unit level (no lower than 40% of committed).
- Add a clause that the credit bucket cannot be combined with any other promotional credits.

I uploaded a proposed amendment redline to the shared drive and started a DocuSign envelope for HelioHealth (link below). If Sean is good with 35% credit, and Soojin confirms finance impact, Legal is ok to proceed.

Redline link: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/redlines/HHL-319-amendment
DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded/signer/track/abc123

Karthik
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Avery Stone <avery.stone@heliohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-19T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: ramp clause opt-out and early-termination credit options

Marissa / Karthik — thank you for the quick turnaround and the revision. HelioHealth is generally comfortable with the revised terms (35% credit bucket applied as account credits, 60-day notice, 2-step staircase) provided: 
1) Credits are usable for any Redwood invoiced services within 12 months (we prefer slightly more flexible use than just the same SOW).
2) The DocuSign amendment reflects that credits are not cash refunds and that the discount is limited to months 1–3.

We reviewed the redline and will sign once DocuSign reflects the 35% figure and clarifies credit usability to cover professional services and add-ons (not just base usage). I'll route to my CFO and sign once we have the final DocuSign.

Avery
Procurement, HelioHealth
